indicator_name: Average annual population by region: total, urban, rural, by sex
description: Среднегодовая численность населения по регионам: всё население, город, село, по полу
methodology: Items ALL, URBAN, RURAL and their MEN/WOMEN splits (ALL_MEN, URBAN_WOMEN …). 1991-2008 on the old boundaries (16 regions: Алматинская incl. Жетісу, ВКО incl. Абай, Карагандинская incl. Ұлытау, YKO = Туркестанская + Шымкент); 2009 onwards recalculated by BNS for the 2022 regions -- do not splice regions across 2008/2009. 1991-2007 = mean of the adjacent 1 January stocks (POPULATION_BOY_BY_REGION) exactly. 2008 is printed as the post-census 1 Jan 2009 stock (15 982 370), not an average (source_issues population_avg_2008). Census steps not backcast: +204 869 in 2008/09, +380 751 in 2021/22.
